$Comment: What a Christmas Present holds when a player opens it. The present's use runs its open chain
(Item/Interactions/Christmas/Christmas_Present_Open.json), which hands this table out by id, so
retuning the gift is an edit here and nowhere else.
The roll always pays a few Christmas Coins, through the Currency reward kind. Pool is one draw from
the bag below, weighted against each other: mostly a treat (candy canes, a cookie, a cocoa) or a
handful of snowballs, now and then a Winter Bauble or one of the game's Christmas Packets. Every item
goes where the opening player's pickup settings send it, with the game's own pickup notice, and
whatever their bag cannot take drops at their feet.
The table pays whenever a present is opened, in season or out, since a present kept from December
is an ordinary item. A companion mod adds its own rolls with a file of its own that names this table
Text names this table wherever a reward paying it is shown and gives its hover a line; the hover
then lists what this table pays.
Name: Christmas_Present_Gift
